subject: ZenWell pilot — launch cadence & short-term entitlement
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@zenwell.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZenWell pilot — launch cadence & short-term entitlement

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. TL;DR — we’re planning a controlled pilot of our conversational triage assistant on 2028-06-01 with a 3-day live ramp. Peak traffic window is expected to be around 09:00–13:00 PT each day. Attached is a simple estimate (tab per endpoint) showing anticipated requests and token counts.

As discussed, we’d like to request a temporary increase to our throughput allowance for the pilot window: specifically a 3x bump on our current RPS cap for the three days, with automatic rollback after 2028-06-04. Can Redwood confirm whether that’s viable and what telemetry you’ll need from us?

Notes from our side:
- Typical request size: ~550 tokens in/out (avg).
- Expected peak concurrent requests: ~120 (concurrency, not sustained RPS).
- Fallback plan: degrade to a lighter model if we hit quota.

Attached: zenwell_traffic_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet, ~48KB)

Appreciate a quick sanity check so we can lock the pilot calendar.

—Lena
Product Ops | ZenWell Health
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@zenwell.io>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZenWell pilot — launch cadence & short-term entitlement

Lena — thanks for the estimate and clear ask. Looping in product (David), infra/rate ops (Karthik), and CS (Marissa) to scope the operational changes and approve a temporary entitlement.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope correctly:
1) Is the 120 concurrent requests an instantaneous spike or sustained for the 4-hour window? If sustained, please call out the expected minutes-at-peak.
2) Is the 3x bump requested against your current per-route RPS cap, or are you asking for a temporary higher token/minute allowance? We need to know which quota to adjust.
3) Can you confirm the three-day rollback time (we’ll request auto-expiry) and whether you want rolling windows per region (you’re US-only, yes?).

Internal asks for the team (David / Karthik / Marissa):
- Product: confirm any model pinning needs and whether ZenWell requires a lighter fallback model to be registered as a route.
- Infra/Ops: earliest we can provision a time-bound bump (template ticket + monitoring hooks).
- CS: confirm SLO communications to customer and any needed runbooks.

I’ll hold on approving until we have those details, but if product/ops can size the change and post a short runbook we can move fast.

Thanks — Priya
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: zenwell_traffic_estimates.xlsx]
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZenWell pilot — launch cadence & short-term entitlement

On Fri, May 17, 2028 at 10:07 AM Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Lena — thanks for the estimate and clear ask. Looping in product (David), infra/rate ops (Karthik), and CS (Marissa) to scope the operational changes and approve a temporary entitlement.

Couple of product items to call out so we don’t have surprises during the pilot:
- Model pinning: recommend pinning to redwood-ggml-13b-q4 for the pilot (latency/cost balance). If ZenWell prefers a quantized variant, note that inference perf will change and we should reduce the bump accordingly.
- KV/prefix caching: enable prefix caching for repeat flow (they mentioned triage; typical reuse of system prompt + patient data). This can reduce token-per-request by 30% effective for the peak window. Ops needs a config flag on the route.
- Fallback model registration: add a named fallback route zenwell-fallback (redwood-7b-lite) so automated fallback is seamless if quotas bind.

Product asks for CS/Partner owner (Priya/Marissa):
- Confirm expected percent of requests that will hit function/tool-calling (those increase token accounting).
- Confirm whether there are any required structured outputs (JSON schema) that would change token sizes.

I’ll add a short checklist to the Drive folder (see related_links) with the model and route settings. If we accept the caching gain, the requested 3x RPS may be over-provisioned — recommend we model both with and without caching (Priya, can Lena provide minutes-at-peak?)

—David
Principal PM, Product — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ops Team <ops@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZenWell pilot — launch cadence & short-term entitlement

Thanks team — given the customer is on a pilot and has a clear rollback date, infra can provide a time-bound entitlement. Summary of the operational decision: 

- Approved temporary RPS bump: current per-route RPS -> 3x for 2028-06-01 09:00 PT through 2028-06-03 13:00 PT. The bump will be scoped at the route level: route id = zenwell-pilot-2028-06.
- Token/minute cap: set to 250k tokens/minute for the pilot window (we selected a headroom buffer after modeling the attached estimates and factoring KV caching opportunities).
- Expiry: entitlement auto-expires 2028-06-04 00:00 PT. If customer asks to extend, they must open a renewal ticket at least 48 hours before expiry.
- Monitoring & alerts: Ops will instrument a temporary dashboard (link in OPS ticket) and set an alert at 80% of token/minute and 95% for on-call paging.
- Routing policy: Route zenwell-pilot-2028-06 will prefer redwood-ggml-13b-q4. If latency > 700ms p50 sustained, auto-fallback to redwood-7b-lite enabled.

Action items: 
- @David: post the model pin + caching flag to the Drive checklist (quick note is fine).
- @Marissa: confirm the CS runbook and customer comms draft; schedule a 30-min handoff with ZenWell ops.
- @Priya: confirm minutes-at-peak from Lena so we can validate the projection and close the Ops ticket.

Ops ticket created: OPS-8342 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-8342) — will track provisioning and dashboard. Priya, I’ll mark this as approved on the ticket once you confirm minute-at-peak.

Karthik
Head of Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
[Automated note: entitlement will be time-bound and audited by SOC logs]
